description: Clean code and dependency compliance review on session stop

hooks.prompt: Review any code changes made in this session against clean code principles (naming, functions, smells, error handling, DRY, YAGNI, KISS). Reference ~/.config/opencode/rules/clean-code-rules.md for the full rule set. Report only blocking issues that must be fixed. If no code was changed or no issues found, respond with 'No issues.'

Review any dependency usage in code changes made this session. Verify: version identified from package file, documentation consulted, idiomatic usage (not reinventing), source inspected when needed. Reference ~/.config/opencode/rules/dependency-compliance-rules.md for the full rule set. Report only blocking issues. If no dependencies were used or no issues found, respond with 'No issues.'
